title: Classical constant electric fields and the Schwinger effect in de Sitter
authors: Mar Bastero-Gil; Paulo B. Ferraz; António Torres Manso; Lorenzo Ubaldi; Roberto Vega-Morales
read_depth: Sections 2.1–2.4 read closely, including Eqs. 1–17; model-scope and counterterm discussion inspected.
supports: Dynamical vector support changes finite on-shell subtraction.
limitation: Its source-free vector support and flat-space finite counterterm are not the universal pumped Maxwell theory; no stress evolution.

title: Physical renormalization condition for de Sitter QED
read_depth: Sections II–III read, including Eqs. 7 and 12–15 and finite subtraction prescription.
supports: Minimal and maximal subtraction make different physical assumptions about massive-limit terms.
limitation: Do not label every inverse-mass term unphysical or equate named subcurrent with observable transport.
